cover:sun_system.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat floating in a little spacesuit, watching colorful planets circle a glowing friendly Sun

sun_system:1.p: A gigantic glowing Sun beside a tiny blue Earth the size of a pea, showing how enormous our star is, deep starry space

sun_system:2.p: the Sun in the center with eight colorful planets on glowing orbit rings around it, deep starry space, wide view

sun_system:3.p: Eight planets lined up in a row from a blazing Sun outward, each with its own color, ringed Saturn standing out, starry background

sun_system:5.p: A glowing beam of sunlight racing across dark space from the Sun toward a small blue Earth, a tiny stopwatch floating along

sun_system:6.p: A child wearing special dark solar viewing glasses looking at the sky with a careful adult on a sunny rooftop

cover:rocky_planets.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat and spacesuit hopping between four rocky planets, the red one dusty, the blue one with clouds

cover:giant_planets.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat riding a little rocket past giant striped Jupiter and ringed Saturn, blue planets glowing far away

cover:moon.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat sitting on a rooftop at night with a telescope, gazing at a big silvery crescent moon

moon:1.p: A row of moons across a night sky from dark new moon through crescent and half to bright full moon, above a quiet village

moon:2.p: A child at a window pointing a small stick toward a thin crescent moon, comparing its curve, cozy bedroom at night

moon:5.p: a reddish copper full moon during a lunar eclipse above a quiet village, families watching from a hill

cover:stars.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat lying in a summer meadow at night, tracing glowing lines between bright stars with a paw

stars:0.p: A child looking through a telescope at a sky full of stars, one star magnified into a glowing sun with its own little planets

stars:1.p: Three glowing stars side by side in space, one hot blue, one warm yellow, one cool red, softly shining

stars:2.p: A night sky where faint glowing outlines of a bear and other animals are drawn between bright stars, children watching from a hill

stars:3.p: seven bright stars forming a big dipper ladle shape in a deep blue night sky above a pine forest, a child pointing up

stars:4.p: A dotted glowing path running from the edge of a big star dipper up across the night sky to a single bright star

cover:comets.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat waving at a bright comet with a long glowing tail streaking across a starry sky

comets:1.p: A comet flying around a bright Sun, its glowing tail always streaming away from the Sun like hair in the wind

comets:4.p: shooting stars streaking across a summer night sky, two kids lying on a blanket in a meadow making wishes

cover:earth_motion.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat holding a tilted spinning globe next to a lamp, half of the globe lit in daylight

earth_motion:0.p: An apple falling from a tree toward the ground while the Moon hangs in the sky, gentle glowing lines pulling everything together

earth_motion:1.p: A child in a spacesuit leaping super high over the gray Moon surface with a huge happy smile, Earth glowing in the black sky

earth_motion:2.p: The Earth spinning like a top in space, one side bright with sunlight and daytime, the other side dark with city lights

earth_motion:3.p: The Earth traveling along a big glowing oval path around the Sun, small Earths showing its positions through the year

earth_motion:4.p: A tilted Earth at four points around the Sun, with snowy, blooming, summery and autumn colors on the side facing us

earth_motion:5.p: Split scene: kids building a snowman in a snowy Russian town while kids in Australia play on a sunny beach at the same moment

cover:cosmonauts.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat and a little spacesuit saluting beside a tall white rocket on a launch pad at dawn

cosmonauts:6.p: Smiling astronauts floating inside a space station cabin, a juice droplet and a pencil drifting in the air, Earth visible through a round window

cover:universe.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat floating in space in front of a huge glowing spiral galaxy full of stars

universe:0.p: Nested views zooming out from a cozy house to a city, a country, the Earth, the planets and finally a spiral galaxy

universe:2.p: A family lying on blankets in a dark countryside field at night, a pale milky band of countless stars stretching across the sky

universe:3.p: A bright beam of light zooming around the Earth in a glowing ring many times in a blink, a surprised child watching

universe:4.p: A beam of light setting out on an enormous journey through space, passing planets and stars, with a tiny ruler floating along
